Thanks again for taking the intake call yesterday. To keep things efficient for your EU team, would a 90-minute block on the following windows work?

Proposed 90-min blocks (all times CET):
- Option A: Mon 6 May, 14:00–15:30 CET
- Option B: Tue 7 May, 09:00–10:30 CET
- Option C: Wed 8 May, 16:00–17:30 CET (late for us in US pacific)

If none of these land, tell me 2x 60-min slots that work and we’ll compress the agenda. We’ll bring:
- SOC 2 control owners for architecture & ops (Marissa)
- Security lead for pen-test scoping & vendor expectations (Ben)
- A short DPA redline primer and files to share beforehand

Attachments: SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.pdf (high-level list); DPA-Redlines.docx (our current redlines). I’ll also share a Drive folder link once we lock a slot and set permissions.

Thanks — hoping to get this calendared today so you can coordinate internally.
